summary: My work experience sits at the intersection of two things that don't often meet: the boardroom where mining strategy gets decided, and the underground sites where it actually plays out.At McKinsey & Company, I led transformation workstreams for global and Indian mining companies. The core of that work was structured problem-solving — taking a vague, high-level performance gap and breaking it down into a clear, testable diagnosis — combined with stakeholder management, since client teams rarely agreed upfront on what "broken" actually meant. Getting alignment on the diagnosis was often harder than designing the fix.Before that, at MOIL Limited, I managed production planning, safety, and environmental programs across underground mine sites — driving horizontal development to record levels and rebuilding safety protocols from the ground up. That role forced me to own real trade-offs: output targets against safety margins, compliance timelines against what a site could realistically absorb. Decisions there had immediate, physical consequences, which shaped how I think about risk — not as an abstraction, but as something with a direct cost if you get it wrong.The two experiences compound each other. When I evaluated a strategy recommendation at McKinsey, I wasn't just checking whether the logic held — I was checking whether it would survive contact with an actual mine site, because I'd been on that side of the table. That's the skill I'd point to as most transferable: rigorous diagnosis, disciplined risk-weighing, and a bias toward solutions built to hold up in practice, not just on paper.At ISB, I'm sharpening that same combination — building out the analytical and strategic toolkit while keeping the operator's instinct for what actually works

job_description: As a Chief Manager (Mining) at Coal India Limited, I was responsible for overseeing the operations of three coal mining projects: Jharkhand Mining Project, Tapin North, and Tapin South. This role involved comprehensive management of all mining activities, ensuring production efficiency, safety, and compliance with regulations. Additionally, during the COVID-19 lockdown, I implemented specific strategies to manage coal production while adhering to safety protocols and maintaining operational continuity. Implementation of Health and Safety Protocols: Developed and enforced strict health and safety protocols to protect workers from COVID-19. Implemented social distancing measures, provided personal protective equipment (PPE), and conducted regular health screenings. Operational Continuity Planning: Developed contingency plans to ensure operational continuity despite workforce reductions and supply chain disruptions. Implemented staggered shifts and remote working arrangements where possible to minimize contact and maintain productivity. Use of Technology and Remote Monitoring: Leveraged technology for remote monitoring and management of mining operations to reduce the need for on-site personnel. Utilized real-time data analytics and remote communication tools to oversee operations and make data-driven decisions. Supply Chain Management: Coordinated with suppliers to ensure the continuous supply of essential materials and equipment despite logistical challenges. Implemented strategies to mitigate the impact of supply chain disruptions on production schedules. Employee Support and Communication: Maintained open lines of communication with employees to provide updates, support, and address concerns related to COVID-19. Offered mental health support and resources to help employees cope with the stress and uncertainty of the pandemic.
summary: With a robust educational foundation in mining engineering from ISM Dhanbad, graduating in 1987, I embarked on my professional journey with Coal India Limited. Over the past 38 years, I have cultivated a profound and diverse expertise in both underground and open-cast mining operations, navigating through various capacities and roles within the organization.. In the initial 16 years of my tenure, I honed my skills in underground semi-mechanized mining operations. This period involved intensive work in developing and managing mining systems that optimized safety and productivity. I led efforts in implementing advanced mining techniques, including room and pillar mining, longwall mining, and the use of continuous miners and shuttle cars, ensuring efficient coal extraction and minimal environmental impact. My role extended to overseeing ventilation systems, ground control measures, and the application of cutting-edge technology to enhance the safety and efficiency of mining operations. Transitioning to open-cast mechanized mining for the subsequent 17 years, I embraced the challenges of large-scale surface mining projects. Here, I specialized in deploying high-capacity earth-moving machinery such as draglines, shovels, dumpers, and surface miners. My technical acumen facilitated the adoption of modern technologies like GPS-based fleet management systems, automated drilling and blasting techniques, and real-time monitoring systems to optimize production and reduce operational costs. I played a pivotal role in the implementation of highwall mining systems and in-situ gasification projects, pushing the boundaries of coal extraction methodologies. I have been instrumental in spearheading projects that emphasize sustainable mining practices. I have championed the integration of environmentally friendly technologies, such as reclamation planning, water management systems, and the use of renewable energy sources within mining operations. My commitment to safety is unwavering, having developed and enforced rigorous safety protocols, emergency response plans, and training programs aimed at minimizing occupational hazards and ensuring the well-being of the workforce. I have a proven track record in leadership and project management. I have led multidisciplinary teams through complex projects, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. My strategic vision and operational insights have contributed to significant enhancements in productivity, cost-efficiency, and compliance with regulatory standards.
